flora: Mature Gnetales (hardy, low-growing shrubs with broad, leathery leaves)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; tactile, high-quality textures like thick, waxy leathery leaves; emphasis on the resilient, arid-adapted nature of the flora; no sharp aggressive angles; overall ancient and hardy feel.

visual_logic.composition: A low-angle view of a hardy Gnetales shrub, its broad leaves catching the high-key sun. The plant is positioned against a wide, flat playa lake bed that extends to a shimmering heat-haze horizon.
visual_logic.ground: Fine red silt and white crystalline salt-crusts typical of the Lagarcito formation, interspersed with wind-blown botanical litter.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; high-key direct sunlight creating a warm glow, with sharp highlights on waxy leaf surfaces and soft-edged shadows on the silt.
